purpose: Record frozen v1 performance on the reserved post-2022 historical block before v2 development starts.
qualification_reason: TimesFM and Kronos checkpoint pretraining exposure prevents a pristine historical-confirmation claim, but the block remained unused for v1 selection and is valid as a one-shot frozen historical benchmark.

window.origin_rule: include only origins with fill on or after 2023-01-01 whose complete five-session target is present inside retained exact-source data

frozen_candidate.training_rule: fit once using verified target-complete origins ending no later than 2022-12-31; never refit on benchmark outcomes

specialist_contract.timesfm: exact pinned TimesFM 2.5 point return and interval width at the frozen information cutoff
specialist_contract.kronos_one_step: exact pinned Kronos-base close return at the frozen information cutoff

kronos_path.benchmark_counter_start: zero at the first otherwise eligible benchmark origin
kronos_path.inactive_semantics: terminal path return unavailable and no path modifier may fire

replay_contract.risk_state_persistence: continuous across the full benchmark window; no calendar-year reset
replay_contract.execution_source: frozen Databento-derived session path and execution-open semantics

informational_comparator.role: fixed informational comparator only; may not change v1 after the result

interpretation_rule: The result becomes v1's immutable historical benchmark for v2 comparisons. It may inform v2 design only after it is durably recorded; it must never trigger tuning or rewriting of v1.
prospective_evidence_rule: This historical benchmark does not replace or upgrade the separate true-forward Phase-7 prospective evidence contract.
